name: Decompose Monolithic Tax Calculator into Deep Modules
task_description: Decompose OrderTaxCalculator: extract jurisdictional rate lookup behind a narrow interface, preserving 100% existing test behavior without API changes for consumers.

guardrails.design_deep_modules: Design narrow, simple public interfaces hiding rich internal calculation logic
guardrails.require_characterization_tests: Run and verify existing characterization tests before any code modification
guardrails.enforce_behavioral_equivalence: Public API signatures and external behavior must remain 100% unchanged
guardrails.enforce_surgical_diff: Refactor in small verified micro-steps; do not interleave refactoring with feature additions
guardrails.enforce_compound_learning_loop: Record architectural seam boundaries and simplification rules in ADR and completion report

invariants: Run characterization tests before any code edit to anchor baseline behavior
